text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while talking with Mejiro Dober
in the Trainer's Office—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I have brought good news
for Trainer and Mejiro Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Good news...?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Actually, Mejiro Dober-san's achievements during the Junior Class have been recognized, and—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
We have received notice from the URA that
Mejiro Dober is to be awarded
"Best Junior Queen Umamusume"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Best Queen Umamusume" is a title awarded to Umamusume
who excelled in races like the Hanshin JF,
the Triple Tiara, and the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Slots have been established for the Junior, Classic, and Senior stages,
which means this time Mejiro Dober will be selected for the Junior Class...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm...
the Best Queen Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It feels like a dream...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations♪
The award ceremony will be held at a later date,
so it might be a good idea to prepare your comments in advance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
A-an award ceremony!? A speech...!?
Oh, right, of course there'd be one...
What do I do...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-I know!
I have to practice properly...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, you're right...
I need to practice...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And in the blink of an eye, the day of the awards ceremony arrived—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And in the blink of an eye, the day of the awards ceremony arrived—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I'll be okay, I practiced so much.
I'll be fine, I'll be fine, I'll be fine...)

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us hear a few words from
the recipient of the Best Junior-Class Queen Umamusume,
Mejiro Dober-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap clap—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by a shower of congratulatory applause and camera flashes,
Mejiro Dober stands, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Oh no—my mind's going completely blank—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something seems off about her.
She might be so nervous that she's lost for words...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Wanting to cheer her on somehow, I waved at Mejiro Dober with all my might...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Ah... Trainer—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(...Look at that desperately serious face.
Idiot... you're gonna make me laugh.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(...You're trying way too hard, you'll ruin that pretty face.
Jeez... thank you!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "...I would like to offer you... my sincerest gratitude for this."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "...I would like to offer you... my sincerest gratitude for this."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
To be selected for such a wonderful award,
I am truly, deeply honored—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh.
Man, I was so nervous..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Cut the flattery.
In the end, I forgot the comment I prepared and had to make something up on the spot anyway..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's not true. In the end, I forgot the comment I prepared, so I had to make something up on the spot anyway...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Still,
you looked amazing from up on the podium.
With that totally desperate look on your faceâ

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. But really, did you notice?
Trainer, you made the most incredible face.
When I spotted you, I couldn't help but laugh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for cheering me on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer.
Thanks to you... I was able to do my best.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, her brief yet heartfelt comment
at the awards ceremony was met with
warm praise among the fans...
